description: Schema for recording adjudication decisions on disputed annotation segments.

adjudication_id.description: SHA-256 of episode_id + segment_id + adjudicator_id, first 12 hex chars

labels_a.description: Label set from annotator A (primary_intent, secondary_intents, status_layer, confidence)

jaccard.description: Jaccard similarity on full label set (including secondary)

dispute_level.description: no_dispute: labels match within tolerance; minor: secondary intent mismatch; major: primary intent mismatch within same parent; fundamental: different parent categories, or one says BACKGROUND/UNKNOWN vs the other says a specific intent

adjudicator_id.description: Annotator identifier for the third expert

final_label.description: The authoritative intent label after adjudication

notes.description: Any additional notes about edge cases or ontology gaps discovered
